performance_interpretation: Candidate/previous elapsed ratios; reverse ratios inverted. Affinity masks4/16 and both orders. General cases run in separate processes; compiler and subclass suites run as grouped cases. Guarded processes were discarded and retried if rustc appeared. This task ran no build, compression or correctness tests during timing. General outputs checked against Node before timing; compiler/subclass outputs checked every call. Gate rejects >2.5% slower in at least3/4 comparisons (stricter than the previous4/4 criterion). Individual slower cases retained; not a universal speed guarantee.
